name: Magic Number wise EA Profit Loss Live Dashboard v1
summary: This EA is a live dashboard utility that monitors and displays profit/loss statistics grouped by magic number, allowing traders to track performance of multiple EAs running simultaneously. It does not open any trades itself but provides real-time P&L visualization for each magic number identified in the account's open and closed positions.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个实时面板工具，按魔术号分组监控和显示盈亏统计信息，允许交易者跟踪同时运行的多个EA的表现。它本身不进行任何交易，而是为账户中识别到的每个魔术号提供实时盈亏可视化。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个监控面板工具。它的核心功能是扫描账户中所有持仓和历史订单，按魔术号（Magic Number）进行分类汇总，实时计算并展示每个EA的盈亏情况。入场条件不适用，因为该工具不会开仓交易。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及任何仓位计算或下单逻辑。资金管理方面，它仅提供盈亏数据的展示和统计，帮助交易者评估各EA的资金运用效率，但不直接参与资金管理决策。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but a monitoring dashboard utility. Its core function is to scan all open positions and historical orders in the account, aggregate them by Magic Number, and display real-time profit/loss for each EA. Entry conditions are not applicable since this tool does not open trades. Exit conditions are equally not applicable. Regarding position sizing, this EA does not involve any lot calculation or order placement logic. For money management, it only provides P&L data display and statistics to help traders evaluate the capital efficiency of each EA, but does not directly participate in money management decisions. The dashboard likely refreshes on each tick or timer to keep the displayed statistics current across all tracked magic numbers.

parameters.name: ShowClosedTrades
parameters.description: 是否显示历史已平仓订单统计

pros: 支持按魔术号分类监控多个EA的盈亏，便于多策略并行管理
实时刷新面板数据，交易者可快速了解各EA当前表现
作为纯工具不影响任何交易操作，安全无风险
pros_en: Supports monitoring P&L of multiple EAs categorized by magic number, convenient for multi-strategy parallel management
Real-time dashboard refresh allows traders to quickly assess each EA's current performance
As a pure utility it does not affect any trading operations, making it safe and risk-free to run alongside any strategy
cons: 仅提供数据展示，缺乏预警通知功能（如某EA亏损超阈值时报警）
面板界面可能占用图表空间，影响主交易图表的查看体验
无法跨账户监控，仅限于当前账户的持仓和历史数据
cons_en: Only provides data display without alert notification features (e.g., alarming when an EA's loss exceeds a threshold)
The dashboard interface may occupy chart space, interfering with the main trading chart viewing experience
Cannot monitor across accounts, limited to current account's positions and historical data only
improvements: 增加盈亏阈值报警功能，当某魔术号对应EA的亏损超过设定值时自动通知
支持导出统计数据为CSV或Excel格式，便于长期绩效分析
improvements_en: Add P&L threshold alert functionality to automatically notify when an EA's loss for a given magic number exceeds a set value
Support exporting statistical data to CSV or Excel format for long-term performance analysis

risk_points: 该EA为纯监控工具，不执行任何交易操作，无直接风险
面板刷新频率过高可能在大量持仓时轻微影响终端性能
risk_points_en: This EA is a pure monitoring tool that does not execute any trading operations, posing no direct risk
Excessively high dashboard refresh frequency may slightly impact terminal performance when there are many open positions
